general guideline covering EXS-061 (example 28) and this example

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a check of a required quantity is performed and that, when the check finds the quantity insufficient, a concrete acquisition action must follow before the process continues: Model the acquisition action as a task on the branch where the check fails, placed before that branch merges back into the main flow. Do not omit this task, and do not treat the check gateway as the only step on that branch.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that, when the actor does not yet have a required account, the branch for that case begins with the actor entering the requested details and then performing a confirmation step (such as following a message they receive) before the process continues with its main flow

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description names two separately stated activities of the same actor, joined by 'and' under one verb phrase (for example, conducting one kind of study and another kind of study): Model each named activity as its own task, in the order the description gives, connected by sequence flows. Do not merge them into one task that carries the combined name.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists several items to enter or choices to make in one sentence, with one verb governing the list and the items joined by commas or 'and' (for example, two data items to enter after a single verb, or three selections after a single verb)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says several activities are performed independently of each other and all of them must be completed before a later step can begin: Model a parallel gateway that splits the flow into one branch per independent activity, and a parallel gateway that joins those branches so the later step starts only after all of them finish. Do not leave the branches unsynchronized, and do not use an exclusive gateway for a join that requires every branch.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists two or more activities that must all be carried out before the process continues, with no stated order between them, so they may be done in any sequence or concurrently

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that, on one outcome of a decision, the actor enters several pieces of information and then performs a further step on that same outcome, and the description gives no separate decision or wait between the entries and that further step: On that decision outcome, model the entry work as one bpmn:userTask on the outgoing flow of that outcome, labeled with the goal the description gives for that work as a verb-object phrase (not the low-level entry verb or the field names). Model the further step that the description places after it as its own task, connected by a sequence flow, and join the branch to the next step of the process.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that, on one outcome of a decision, the actor enters several pieces of information and then performs a further step on that same outcome, and the description gives no separate decision or wait between the entries and that further step

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two or more activities or branches may run at the same time with no required order, and a later step is described as starting only after all of them are finished (or as needing their results); a branch may also state that some of its work must be repeated a minimum number of times: Open the concurrent branches with a parallel gateway, with one outgoing flow per branch, and close them with a parallel gateway (join) before the dependent step, so the later step waits for all branches. If a branch must repeat its work a stated minimum number of times, model that work as a task inside a loop: an exclusive gateway after the task returns the flow to the task until the minimum count is reached, then passes it on. Add no conditions to the fork or join flows, and do not replace the join with an exclusive gateway.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that two or more activities or branches may run at the same time with no required order, and a later step is described as starting only after all of them are finished (or as needing their results); a branch may also state that some of its work must be repeated a minimum number of times
rules_sent_back.source: learned guideline (refines GW-05), generalized from EXS-061

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one branch or outcome of a decision is followed by several separately named actions performed by different actors or departments (for example, one actor receives materials while another department sets something up), joined by 'and' or 'and also': Model each separately named action as its own task in that branch, with one task per actor action, and do not merge them into one task, even when the actions are described in the same sentence. Place the tasks in parallel after the branch's split, and join them with a parallel gateway when the description requires all of them to be completed before the process continues.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists two or more actions that one actor must carry out, joined by commas and 'and' (for example 'select A, B and C'), with no order stated between them, and the process continues only after all of them are completed
